test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

The committee wanted us to __explain__ this in detail.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Elaborate**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Elaborate **means to explain in detail, which is the same as the underlined word in the sentence. (विस्तार से समझाने के लिए)
 
• The word is often used in academic or professional contexts.
 
 
• **For example**: *The professor asked the students to elaborate on their research findings.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Trouble **means to cause difficulty or distress, which is not the same as explaining in detail. (कठिनाई या कष्ट उत्पन्न करना)
 
• **Collect **means to gather or accumulate, which is not related to explaining in detail. (इकट्ठा करना या संचय करना)
 
• **Keen **means eager or enthusiastic, which is not the same as explaining in detail. (उत्सुक या उत्साही)
